summary.text: On Kaladesh, the Inventors' Fair ends in stolen inventions and abducted inventors, and Tezzeret takes power in Ghirapur as the Consulate imposes martial law, so Pia Nalaar's Renegades revolt with the support of the Gatewatch and Ajani.

Tezzeret has turned Rashmi's invention into a Planar Bridge, powered by aether from the Aether Hub, so the Renegades and the Gatewatch seize the Hub to cut it off, though Baral's taunts draw Chandra away and the Consulate retakes it.

Chandra and Gideon destroy the bridge from inside a thopter while Liliana overwhelms Tezzeret, who escapes with its core, and afterward the Consulate yields to the Renegades and Pia is named consul of Allocation.
